faqs.question: How much is the delivery charge?
faqs.answer: Delivery is 60 BDT inside Dhaka and 100 BDT outside Dhaka (Narayanganj, Gazipur, Chattogram, Sylhet and all other districts). Delivery is FREE on orders of 2000 BDT or more. ডেলিভারি চার্জ: ঢাকার ভিতরে ৬০ টাকা, ঢাকার বাইরে ১০০ টাকা। ২০০০ টাকা বা তার বেশি অর্ডারে ডেলিভারি সম্পূর্ণ ফ্রি।

faqs.question: Is delivery free?
faqs.answer: Yes — delivery is free when your product total is 2000 BDT or more, both inside and outside Dhaka. Below that, delivery is 60 BDT inside Dhaka and 100 BDT outside Dhaka. ২০০০ টাকার বা তার বেশি পণ্য নিলে ডেলিভারি ফ্রি।

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Inside Dhaka it takes 2-3 business days. Outside Dhaka it takes 3-5 business days. ঢাকার ভিতরে ২-৩ কর্মদিবস, ঢাকার বাইরে ৩-৫ কর্মদিবস।

faqs.question: Do you deliver outside Dhaka or all over Bangladesh?
faqs.answer: Yes. We deliver all over Bangladesh by courier. Inside Dhaka the charge is 60 BDT and outside Dhaka it is 100 BDT.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Cash on Delivery (COD) is our standard method — you pay the courier when the parcel arrives, and COD works nationwide. ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি সাপোর্ট করা হয়। If you need any other payment arrangement, our team will confirm it with you on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Do I have to pay in advance?
faqs.answer: No. No advance payment is required for Cash on Delivery orders. You pay only when you receive the parcel.

faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: Just message us on WhatsApp with the product you want, your name, your mobile number and your full delivery address. We confirm the product and the total bill (product price + delivery charge) before dispatch.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to order?
faqs.answer: No account or website sign-up is needed. Orders are placed directly over WhatsApp.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 30-day exchange/return for unused products in original condition. Message us on WhatsApp with your order number to start the process.

faqs.question: Can I exchange for a different size or colour?
faqs.answer: Yes, an exchange is possible within 30 days for unused products in original condition, subject to stock availability. Ask us on WhatsApp and we will arrange it.

faqs.question: What if my item arrives damaged or defective?
faqs.answer: Please send us photos of the damage on WhatsApp straight away. Our team will arrange a replacement or another resolution under our 30-day exchange/return policy.

faqs.question: Are your products genuine leather?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hide Haven products are made from 100% genuine cowhide/leather — wallets, long wallets, belts, backpacks and combo sets.

faqs.question: What is the quality of your products?
faqs.answer: All our items are made from genuine cowhide/leather and are checked before dispatch. Every leather product carries a 2-year warranty, and our 30-day exchange/return policy applies to unused products in original condition.

faqs.question: Do your products have a warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes — every Hide Haven leather product comes with a 2-year warranty. সমস্ত লেদার পণ্যে ২ বছরের ওয়ারেন্টি রয়েছে। If you have a warranty concern, message us on WhatsApp and our team will assist you.

faqs.question: How long is the warranty?
faqs.answer: All our leather products are covered by a 2-year warranty. Message us with a description or photo if you need to make a claim and our team will help you.

faqs.question: What belt sizes are available?
faqs.answer: Our belts come in standard adjustable sizes. Send us your waist size on WhatsApp and our team will confirm the correct fit for you before dispatch.

faqs.question: Do you have a size guide?
faqs.answer: Tell us your waist size (or the item you normally wear) on WhatsApp and our team will recommend the right size and confirm availability before you order.

faqs.question: Do you have combo offers or discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes — our belt + wallet combo sets cost less than buying the items separately. New customers also get 10% off with the coupon code comeback10 (on orders up to 3000 BDT). Ask us on WhatsApp for the current combo list and prices.

faqs.question: Do you have a discount code for new customers?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you are a new customer, use the coupon code comeback10 to get 10% off your order. The code can be used once per customer and applies to orders up to 3000 BDT. নতুন ক্রেতা হলে comeback10 কুপন কোড ব্যবহার করে ১০% ছাড় পাবেন।

faqs.question: Do you offer wholesale or bulk pricing?
faqs.answer: Yes. For wholesale/bulk purchases our store admin shares special rates and the minimum order quantity on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Do you accept corporate or business orders?
faqs.answer: Yes, we take business and bulk orders. Message us on WhatsApp and our admin will discuss quantity and pricing with you.

faqs.question: Can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Yes. We share order updates on WhatsApp and parcels are handed to our courier partner (Steadfast). Ask us any time and we will check the latest status of your order for you.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: The fastest way is this WhatsApp chat — our team replies here. If your issue needs a human, just ask and we will connect you with our store admin.

faqs.question: Can I talk to a human or the manager?
faqs.answer: Yes. Just ask for a human and we will connect you with our store admin on WhatsApp, who will follow up with you directly.
